I'll be syncing with Samantha later today. If you need legal/finance sign-off, loop in Neha and I'll escalate.

Marcus / Karthik —

Pulling a short mitigation plan together now. Preliminary notes after reviewing Marcus's draft and Samantha's reply:
- Critical gating items: SOC2 evidence package (we have export), sandbox allowlist (network ops can support a CIDR allowlist by next-business-day), legal redlines (2-3 business days once we accept final ask)
- Risk items: potential procurement budget window (if they miss the current internal fiscal cutoff, decision may slip to Q1), internal exec reprioritization at Acme if we don't show flexibility

Proposed quick MAP (deliverables + owners):
1) SOC2 artifacts delivered — owner: Karthik — target: 2026-09-03 17:00 PDT
2) Sandbox allowlist provided — owner: Infrastructure Ops (via Karthik) — target: 2026-09-04 09:00 PDT
3) Legal redline response — owner: Legal (cc Neha) — target: 2026-09-06 EOD
4) Exec touchpoint + final acceptance date — owner: Marcus — target: 2026-09-07

Concession recommendation: offer one-time 15% onboarding credit if Acme signs by 2026-09-14. It keeps economics tight and gives procurement a tangible incentive. If that lands, we should pre-clear finance/price desk.

I'm attaching an export (acme-risk-log-0902.csv) with initial probability/impact scoring.

Will refine and send final MAP tomorrow morning.

— Lauren
